name: PLAENGYAO 35K Super Half Marathon 2026
short_description: PLAENGYAO 35K Super Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 25 October 2026 at Wang Yen Subdistrict Municipality in Plaeng Yao, Chachoengsao, over 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and 35 km.
ai_summary: PLAENGYAO 35K Super Half Marathon 2026 is organised by Run Yao and based at the Wang Yen Subdistrict Municipality office in Plaeng Yao district, Chachoengsao, with entries on Regis.run. Alongside the 35 km it offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. The 35 km, 21 km and 10 km are chip-timed.

faqs.question: How much does the PLAENGYAO 35K Super Half Marathon cost?
faqs.answer: The Regis.run page lists the 35 km at THB 900, the 21 km at THB 800, the 10 km at THB 650 and the 5 km at THB 500. Every entry includes a shirt, race number, cloth bag and a finisher medal.

faqs.question: Which PLAENGYAO distances are chip-timed?
faqs.answer: The 35 km, 21 km and 10 km are listed with chip timing. The 5 km entry does not mention a chip.
